purpose: Teach: 一人ひとり/要注意/停電/クッション/ワンピース/落ち込む/ねぎ/玉ねぎ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、クラスメート、絶対、一人ひとり、絶対、大事にね
lines.en: Riku — seriously, you've got to care about every single one of your classmates, no exceptions.
lines.style: Direct, firm, no backing down. Eyes locked. Quick tempo on the repeated absolutes — driving the point home. Breath underneath, like she's been holding this in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、試合中、本気で、絶対、要注意、絶対、選手、絶対、いるぜ、桜
lines.en: You — there are players in the match I'm seriously worried about. Sakura, I'm being real with you.
lines.style: Guarded at first, then softer. Glances away before meeting her eyes. Measured, careful — he's about to say something that matters to him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、昨夜の、本気で、絶対、停電、絶対、お前のとこ、絶対、大丈夫だった?本気で
lines.en: Riku — were you okay last night when the power went out at your place?
lines.style: Casual opener, then genuine concern underneath. Leans forward slightly. Soft on the question mark — checking if he's allowed to ask.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、クッション、絶対、可愛いな、桜
lines.en: Your cushion's cute, Sakura. I like it.
lines.style: Quietly observant, almost offhand. No performance — just noticing something small about her. Warm but still cool-distant on the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお姉ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、ワンピース、絶対、お洒落だったね
lines.en: Your sister's dress was really stylish the other day, wasn't it?
lines.style: Light, approving. Genuine admiration without edge. Comfortable rhythm — this is easy ground between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで、本気で、絶対、落ち込む、絶対、なよ、桜
lines.en: Don't get down on yourself about the test, okay? You're going to be fine.
lines.style: Firm but soft. No lecturing — the voice of someone who believes it. Steady, encouraging. A small breath before 'okay' — he means it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お好み焼きの、本気で、絶対、ねぎ、絶対、足りないぜ
lines.en: Riku — there's not enough green onion in your okonomiyaki, man.
lines.style: Dry, teasing. Quick clip on 'enough.' Familiar ground — this is how they talk. A hint of affection underneath the complaint.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の母さんの、本気で、絶対、玉ねぎ、絶対、カレー、絶対、ウマかったぜ、桜
lines.en: Your mom's curry with all that onion in it was seriously delicious, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, unselfconscious praise. Slower tempo on 'delicious' — he's really saying it. No hesitation, just genuine appreciation. Comfortable gratitude.
